# okstatus_monitor_groups (Data Source)

Every monitor group (the folders of the Monitors page) of the org that owns the configured API key, in dashboard order, each with the ids of its monitors — read-only, e.g. to find a group created in the dashboard by its name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "okstatus_monitor_groups" "all" {}

# Find a group created in the dashboard by its name.
locals {
  payments_group = one([for g in data.okstatus_monitor_groups.all.groups : g if g.name == "Payments"])
}

output "payments_monitor_count" {
  value = length(local.payments_group.monitor_ids)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) One entry per group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier — this data source has no single ID of its own, required by the Terraform plugin framework.
- `total` (Number) Number of monitor groups in the org.

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `alert_channel_ids` (Set of String) Alert channels attached to any monitor that joins the group.
- `color` (String) Preset key of the dashboard's palette.
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `monitor_ids` (Set of String) Ids of the group's monitors.
- `muted` (Boolean) The group was muted as a whole from the dashboard.
- `name` (String)
- `paused` (Boolean) The group was paused as a whole from the dashboard.
- `tags` (Set of String) The group's own tags.
